_about: Every number the manual may print, with its provenance. data.json (extracted from guide.html's D object) holds coordinates; this file holds everything else. Units: mm unless the key says cm. Confidence labels: VERIFIED = measured on the purchased part or taken from its own geometry file; SOURCE = defined by the project documents (docs/build-manual.md); ASSUMPTION = engineering estimate or field check.
source_commit: HEAD of https://github.com/scotthowson/desk-setup on 23 Oct 2026 (supersedes a2e99ea with measured facts)

heights_mm.confidence: SOURCE; ALEX height ASSUMPTION until measured; top thickness MEASURE ON HARDWARE (expect 28)

tops.name: IKEA EKBACKEN brown walnut
tops.why_21: 28 mm particleboard with a thin laminate skin; a screw reaching the skin lifts it
tops.if_27: nothing changes: the deepest screw (rail #10 x 1, 20.6 in) still stops 6 mm short of the laminate; under 27, stop and ask

topA.runs: along the back wall, keeps the corner square

topB.runs: along the side wall, butts into A's front edge at y = 65

legs.note: all on the wall edges; L1 under VIVO clamp 2; plate 105 mm

feet.note: 5 cm in from each ALEX corner = 8.5 cm in from the top's edges; F2 F4 F7 F8 are 8.5 from the far end (feet corner jig), F1 F3 F5 F6 are 34.5 cm from the far end: hook the tape on the far end, the same end the cabinet is set from; never from the other end

rails.note: 12 cm back from the front edges; vertical leg's outer face at y = 53 (A) and x = 53 (B); B's corner end touches A's vertical leg; neither rail touches a cabinet

joining_plates.note: not centred on the joint; 3 mm clear of rail A

olov.pattern: regular pentagon; the leg jig puts one hole toward the wall on L2-L6
olov.screws: M4 x 16 mm fully threaded, IKEA part 108443, 5 per leg, 30 total
olov.confidence: VERIFIED: 105 mm plate measured 22 Oct 2026; hole pattern from a shared OLOV template (schablone.stp) that was printed and test-fitted; leg jig matches it to 0.01 mm

feet.name: round adjustable feet, 4 in
feet.screws: #8 x 5/8 in pan head, 4 per plate, 32 total; 14 mm into the top
feet.load_rating: unknown (design wants 50 kg or more each)
feet.confidence: VERIFIED on the purchased plate 23 Oct 2026 (46.8 from 41.6 inside jaws and 52.0 outside jaws); load rating ASSUMPTION
feet.height_gauge_when: gauge every foot loose, before its plate is screwed on; the C sits against the plate face

rings.screws: #6 x 5/8 in flat head, 3 per ring, 24 total; 13.4 mm into the ALEX top
rings.confidence: VERIFIED from its own geometry file; pad diameter 50 MEASURE ON HARDWARE; ALEX top panel 15.9 mm (5/8 in) VERIFIED 23 Oct 2026, 2.5 mm remains under the 13.4 mm screws
rings.fitting_method: by tracing: stand the top on the bare cabinet with 3.5 cm of top showing all round (wall gauge 65 leg at the wall), pencil round each pad, lift the top off, set each ring on its circle (pencil line visible all round through the open bottom), pilot through the ring's own holes 3-4 mm, lift, finish with the 12 ALEX puck, three #6 x 5/8; stand the top up again and the pads drop in. The corner template is the check, not the method.
rings.angles_note: the ring's own three holes are at 90/210/330 in its file; the printed template and the paper template drill at 45/165/285 from the cabinet corner; the ring is round and is simply turned so its holes sit on whichever three pilots it meets

alex_feet_optional.confidence: SOURCE (optional; the model and all fixed numbers stay at 802/830)

steel.purchased_as: 84 in = 2133.6 mm, cut by Metal Supermarkets Ottawa; measure the delivered length; 2130 is the layout length and the far end may carry the extra

railB.fitting_heel: at the corner end (0 cm), legs toward the far end

steel.rail_screws: #10 x 1 in pan head, Robertson; 20.6 mm into the top; 19 total
steel.rail_pilot: 1/8 in, 25 mm from the face of the flat leg the puck stands on (the floor side) = 20 mm into the wood (puck 25 RAIL)
steel.finish: degrease, 120 grit, two coats flat black enamel, 24 h
steel.confidence: SOURCE for all positions; delivered length MEASURE ON HARDWARE
steel.rail_end_caps: handed: cap A fits rail A's far end (1); cap B fits rail A's wall end and rail B's far end (2), because rail B's far end is the mirror image of rail A's far end about the desk's diagonal; rail B's corner end is bolted to rail A and takes no cap

corner_joint.fittings: two 5 mm gusseted 90-degree strut fittings for 1-5/8 in channel; measured 23 Oct 2026: legs 100.5 long x 41 wide, two slots 21 x 12 mm per leg, slot centres 29.15 and 78.45 mm from the heel (49.3 apart), first slot's near edge 18.65 from the heel, last slot's far edge 11.5 from the leg's end
corner_joint.placement: one each side of rail B's end: outside fitting with its heel at the outside corner (legs on rail A's vertical leg toward the far end and on rail B's outer face, gusset facing the open knee space); inside fitting with its heel at the inside corner (legs on rail A's vertical leg toward the wall end and on the inner face of rail B's vertical leg), gusset pointing at the floor
corner_joint.bolts: six 3/8-16 x 1-1/2 in hex bolts, grade 5: four through rail A's vertical leg (one fitting each), two through rail B's leg with a fitting on each side; washer under head and nut; nylon-insert nuts
corner_joint.torque: 25 N·m (18 ft·lb), under the standard dry torque even for a grade 2 bolt; or one hand's full pull on a 15 cm wrench
corner_joint.why_tight: friction joint: the fittings' 21 x 12 mm slots leave 2.5 mm of play across and 11.5 mm along each bolt, the 7/16 in rail holes 1.6 mm
corner_joint.hole_positions_from_heel: VERIFIED 23 Oct 2026: 29.15 and 78.45 mm (slot centres); the fitting with the printed slot plug is still the drilling template
corner_joint.confidence: SOURCE placement; fitting geometry VERIFIED 23 Oct 2026 (thickness 5 from the listing)

vivo.lower_pad: oval 90 x 50 mm, from 13.5 to 63.5 mm in from the edge, on the steel plate
vivo.pad_plates: two spare 10 x 3 x 0.12 in mending plates between the lower jaw and the top
vivo.confidence: VERIFIED: crossbar, pole, pole inset, clamp back, pad all measured 21-23 Oct 2026; top arm reach ASSUMPTION about 89; max opening MEASURE ON HARDWARE (needs 31 mm or more)

monitors.centre: Samsung Odyssey G5 32 in, 1000R, VESA 75, about 5 kg, bottom edge 230 mm above the top, top edge 669 (limit 673)
monitors.sides: two Acer XZ320QU 31.5 in, 1500R, VESA 100, 5.6 kg with stand, about 5 kg on the arm

H01.name: M4 x 16 mm machine screw, IKEA 108443 (with the OLOV legs)

H06.name: #6 x 5/8 in flat head
H06.use: rings, 3 each (plus 24 for the optional ALEX feet and more for cable parts)

H09.name: 3/8 flat washer
H09.use: under each bolt head and nut

parts.P04: ALEX 2, storage unit with door 360 x 580 x 700
parts.P11: Mending plate 10 x 3 x 0.12 in x 4 (two joining, two clamp pads)
parts.P18: Printed tools: T-square, leg jig, feet corner jig, ALEX corner template, rail gauge, rail drill jig, fitting centring plug x 2, drill guide (tower + 5 pucks), foot height gauge, wall gauge
parts.P19: Wall-gap trim (optional): corner, fillers, clamp pieces, segments, connector tiles
parts.P20: ALEX feet (optional) x 8 with TPU pads
parts.P21: Cable parts (optional): hooks, clips, cradles, tray

printed_tools.edge-t-square: lip over an edge; station holes 50 ALEX ring, 85 foot (with the 4 feet plate holes at 46.8, 1/8 in), 100 leg, 150 L1
printed_tools.leg-jig: lip over the wall edge; OLOV centre + 5 holes (1/8 in) at 100 (L2-L6, solid circle) and 150 (L1, dashed circle, ringed holes)
printed_tools.feet-corner-jig: fences on a far corner; foot centre 85/85 + 4 holes (1/8 in) at 46.8: F2 F4 F7 F8
printed_tools.alex-corner-template: fences on an ALEX corner; ring centre 50/50 + 3 ring holes (5/64 in, r 33) + 3 ALEX-foot holes (r 14.5), top and bottom corners
printed_tools.rail-marking-gauge: lip over the angle's edge; pencil notches at 19 (screw line) and 29 (bolt line)
printed_tools.rail-drill-jig: lip over the flat leg's free edge; 1/8 in bore on the 19 line; sight grooves
printed_tools.fitting-centring-plug: slot plug: drops into a fitting's 21 x 12 slot; 1/8 in bore dead centre; print 2
printed_tools.pilot-drill-guide: SET tower (45 mm for 1/8, 35 mm for 5/64) and five pucks: 12 PLATE, 15 LEG, 10 EDGE, 12 ALEX, 25 RAIL
printed_tools.wall-gauge: L: 65 mm (ALEX back to wall) and 30 mm (top's raw edge to wall)
printed_tools.rule: every jig hole is bit-sized: start the pilot 3-4 mm through the jig, lift it, finish to depth with the puck; centre holes are scriber only

procedures.corner_load_test: 20 kg (a case of water plus a few books) on top B's inside corner, 10 cm in from both edges; straightedge from leg L1's line across the corner: no more than 2 mm drop (estimate about 1); remove: returns, no creak, nothing moved; never stand or sit on the corner
procedures.sideways_push: push the desk along each wall: no sway beyond a few mm at the top, no movement of a top on its ALEX
procedures.pads: rock each pad sideways by hand; do not turn it (turning changes the height); none rocks or lifts
procedures.settling: straightedge across the joint at the inside corner: write the step down; re-check at two weeks and one month; retighten the six fitting bolts if it settled
procedures.surface_height: 83.0 cm at all six corners of the L, +/- 3 mm (plus ALEX feet height if fitted); adjust (0,0) by L1/L2, (249,0) and (249,65) by the ALEX 1 feet, (0,314) and (65,314) by the ALEX 2 feet, (0,65) by L4; the inside corner (65,65) has no support and follows the joint
procedures.trim_fitting: step 8b, after the mount: take the screens, PC and everything loose off; measure the gap at the wall, print, slide the desk 40 cm off both walls, fit the chain with connector tiles, pilot 10 EDGE horizontal, #4 x 1/2 screws, slide back until the wall gauge's 65 leg just fits at each ALEX
procedures.rings_by_trace: by tracing: stand the top on the bare cabinet with 3.5 cm of top showing all round (wall gauge 65 leg at the wall), pencil round each pad, lift the top off, set each ring on its circle (pencil line visible all round through the open bottom), pilot through the ring's own holes 3-4 mm, lift, finish with the 12 ALEX puck, three #6 x 5/8; stand the top up again and the pads drop in. The corner template is the check, not the method.
procedures.trim_gap_table: smallest gap reading -> gap value: 27 -> 26, 28 -> 27, 29 -> 28, 30 -> 29 (as saved), 31 -> 30, 32 -> 31, 33 -> 32; under 27 or over 33: measure again and ask
procedures.alex2_staging: step 5 places ALEX 2 with its near end 292.5 cm from the back wall (15 cm short of the final 277.5) so top B can be stood on it with rail B's 12 cm projection clear of top A; in step 7 ALEX 2 is pushed home with the pads in its rings and top B comes with it
procedures.never_push_the_top: once the pads are in the rings, push the ALEX unit and the top comes with it; never push or lift the top alone
procedures.plates_pilot: scribe through the plate's holes, plate off, pilot 1/8 x 12 with the 12 PLATE puck standing on the wood, plate back, screws
procedures.heel_marks: scribe the 51.5 and 52.0 cm heel positions on rail A's vertical leg; after painting, tape and re-label the 52.0 mark and both rail ends; step 7 checks rail B's outer face against 52.0

tools_note: the 3/8-16 bolt head and nut take a 9/16 in wrench or socket; two needed
open_measurements: ALEX height with and without its stock feet (docs assume 700)
VIVO top arm reach (about 89) and max opening (31 or more)
delivered rail lengths and angle thickness (4.8)
room: wall to wall 2520 and 3170, baseboard thickness
ALEX bottom panel thickness (only for the optional ALEX feet)
